title: Better when roasted
slide_intent: Use a familiar diagram to deliver a verbal twist so a short message rewards recognition.
strategic_value: The shared roasted punchline can give Sweetgreen’s food communication a conversational sense of humor.
demonstration: Two pale circles overlap on green; the top labels a friend who dislikes salad, the bottom Roma tomatoes, and the bright intersection reads Better when roasted.
practical_value: Match a short joke to a visual structure that makes the shared meaning immediately legible.

content_islands.name: Two subjects
content_islands.spec: Set the friend and tomato labels in separate overlapping circles.

content_islands.name: Shared punchline
content_islands.spec: Place Better when roasted in the vivid central intersection.

reference_purposes.Expression: A Venn-style composition turns roasted into a shared joke about people and tomatoes.
reference_purposes.Application: The artwork demonstrates a compact brand-voice composition.
